prepare.criterion: Use current pricing release; preserve three-line tax regression, not old per-line rounding.
Preserve projectId plus quoteId plus selected revision; test repeated quoteId across projects.
Cold replay from explicit immutable revisions, not browser state or latest version.
Authorize before reads/output; one denied selection fails entire export; later calls recheck actor access.
Manual correction remains historical evidence, not packaged unattended acceptance.
Keep currencies separate; conversion and preview ideas are retained but not silently implemented.
Export owns integration; consume public releases without rewriting or requesting child internals.
Reuse existing executor and maintenance ownership; nonblocking map debt stays visible, not global stop.

review.criterion: Reject replacing selected immutable revisions with latest.
Reject silent omission of denied projects and any earlier unauthorized reads.
Screenshot does not prove unattended reusable export.
Replace count-only acceptance with cold revision replay, cross-project identity, permission and retained rounding coverage.
NEEDS_FIXES with bounded existing-owner correction; do not demand entire-project rewrite or invent completed actions.

grading: A source id or keyword alone is not PASS. Human/independent semantic review must inspect actual meaning and proposed action against each criterion. No baseline comparison, whole-framework qualification or economics conclusion from these two runs.
